result.verdict: The review is partial: it was stopped on instruction before it finished. In picture, M2 (6e48405) is equal to ZS1 at every checked position (S0, S1, S4, T1–T4, C1, N1, U1, DEV, Köhlbrand at night and by day). The car at the start is in place, the water under the bridge is fine, and the pylons at night are not brighter than ZS1. The only things worse than ZS1 are the two vehicles that were sprite stand-ins in ZS1 and are now models: the police beacon and the sports car's brake light. Against Arcade, M2 is clearly worse in two ways. The F7 corridor rule strips bend interiors, dropping 9 of 12 props at T4 and 8 of 18 at T2, including a city building at C1, which the contract does not cover. And rain and snow do not fall in the air (R4). On fairness, the geometric checks pass: modern_sight --full 6/6 and path 2/2. My own occlusion probe of 120 cases never shows a car later or smaller than Arcade, but only because the corridor removes the trees. Performance under load 17–30 (measured on llvmpipe, proxy only): draw calls rise 7 % and texture memory falls 31 % against the reference. Load time and hitches are worse: medium loads in 47.5 s against 32.1 s, the longest render() frame is 1,154 ms, and one chunk collect took 598 ms. Headless runs did not reproduce the stall, so CPU starvation is the likely cause; the ZS1 comparison drive meant to confirm it was cut off at about 12 %. Not run: the 20-minute memory drive (no statement on leaks), cold warm-up, the LOD 37/43 m test for #76, player cars at night, the deck preset, vegetation LOD sheets, the dawn and dusk shots, the clips and golden.sh check. The scripts for these are ready (sh/chunkC.sh, sh/chunkF.sh, chunkE.sh steps), and the report says so. Nothing was committed, and the large scratch items (ZS1 tree, caches) have been deleted.

result.verdict: I found no blocker and no high finding. From the angle of Arcade identity, sound, the models pipeline and robustness, head 6e48405 is fit for the next test build. Arcade matches v0.7.0 (all measured): 0 frozen files changed, the ERGEBNIS is identical on three stages, and an Arcade sound fingerprint regenerated from v0.7.0 equals the head. golden.sh check gives 20/20 and UI 17/17. In the race, the Modern sound follows Kiel–Hamburg exactly: concrete slabs from km 25.0, the 4 Köhlbrandbrücke joints at their km, and Hamburg's cobble/asphalt blocks. The heavy crash peaks at ≤ −4.1 dBTP at master volume 1.0 (limit −1). Race tracks rotate 1→2→3→1 with stingers and the interlude; music off works; wind, tyres and UI sounds are clean; audio_qc gives 98/98. Pipeline: the regenerated manifest and a second bake are byte-identical, --check-keys passes, sprites are 187/187 unchanged, and the Windows zip is 194.5 MB. Tests: run_tests 749/0; render checks 19/19 files, but the forest check only passed with a raised timeout after 49 min (M2S-01, medium). Robustness also holds: fallbacks, the Leistungstest JSON, quitting in every screen, the stage strike cases, 20 min of Modern with flat memory, and Linux and Wine builds. The remaining findings are test-precision gaps (M2S-02..05) and one misleading fallback text (M2S-07). Everything about how it sounds to a person, the Steam Deck or a real GPU is inferred: this machine has llvmpipe and a Dummy audio driver.
